description: Bridge-generated from schemas/uml-foundation.ts — a normalisation of schemas-lib src/schemas/domains/uml (UML 2.5.1). Twenty-two metaclasses as primitives (Package, Model, Class, Interface, DataType, PrimitiveType, Enumeration, EnumerationLiteral, Property, Operation, Parameter, Association, AssociationClass, Component, Port, Connector, ConnectorEnd, Artifact, Signal, Reception, Constraint, Comment) and twenty-four typed edges for ownership, typing, generalisation, realisation, dependency, association ends, annotation and constraint.
label: UML 2.5.1 (Foundation subset)
name: UML

relation_types.description: Namespace ownership — Package::packagedElement (§12.2.3). The owned element is deleted with its owner.
relation_types.name: owns

relation_types.description: Classifier::ownedAttribute (§9.2.3) — the classifier's structural features, in order.
relation_types.name: owns_attribute

relation_types.description: Classifier::ownedOperation (§9.6) — the classifier's behavioral features, in order.
relation_types.name: owns_operation

relation_types.description: BehavioralFeature::ownedParameter (§9.4) — the operation's signature, in order.
relation_types.name: owns_parameter

relation_types.description: Enumeration::ownedLiteral (§10.5.3) — the enumeration's values, in order.
relation_types.name: owns_literal

relation_types.description: Generalization (§9.9): source is the specific classifier, target the general one. The Generalization element's own xmi:id is not preserved — see declaredLoss.

fields.description: Whether the specific classifier can substitute for the general one.
fields.name: is_substitutable

relation_types.name: specializes

relation_types.description: InterfaceRealization (§10.4.4) — the classifier implements the interface's contract.
relation_types.name: realizes

relation_types.description: Dependency (§7.8) — the client requires the supplier. `kind` carries the standard specialisation.
relation_types.name: depends_on

relation_types.description: TypedElement::type (§7.7) — the classifier that types this property, parameter or result.
relation_types.name: typed_by

relation_types.description: Association::memberEnd (§11.5.3) — the two or more properties that are the association's ends.

fields.description: 0-based end order; end 0 is the source end by convention.
fields.name: position

fields.description: Whether the end is navigable from the opposite end.
fields.name: is_navigable

relation_types.name: member_end

relation_types.description: Class::ownedReception (§11.4) — the receptions declaring which signals the classifier reacts to.
relation_types.name: owns_reception

relation_types.description: Reception::signal (§11.4) — the signal the reception reacts to.
relation_types.name: signals

relation_types.description: EncapsulatedClassifier::ownedPort (§11.3) — the interaction points on the classifier's boundary. A port is an owned attribute of a particular kind, so it is listed here rather than under uml:OwnsAttribute.
relation_types.name: owns_port

relation_types.description: StructuredClassifier::ownedConnector (§11.2) — the links between the classifier's parts and ports.
relation_types.name: owns_connector

relation_types.description: Connector::end (§11.2) — the two or more endpoints the connector joins, in order.
relation_types.name: owns_connector_end

relation_types.description: ConnectorEnd::role (§11.2) — the part or port this end attaches to. Both are properties in UML; a port is the encapsulated kind.
relation_types.name: connector_role

relation_types.description: ConnectorEnd::partWithPort (§11.2) — when the role is a port, the containing part whose port it is.
relation_types.name: part_with_port

relation_types.description: The interfaces a port or component offers to its environment (§11.3, §11.6). Derived in UML from the realizations of the port's type; stored here because it is the contract a reader needs.
relation_types.name: provides

relation_types.description: The interfaces a port or component needs from its environment (§11.3, §11.6).
relation_types.name: requires

relation_types.description: ComponentRealization (§11.6): the classifier implements the component's contract. Modelled as an edge, like the other DirectedRelationships — the realization element's own identity is not preserved (see declaredLoss).
relation_types.name: realizes_component

relation_types.description: Artifact::manifestation (§19.2) — the model elements this physical artifact embodies.
relation_types.name: manifests

relation_types.description: Artifact::nestedArtifact (§19.2) — artifacts contained inside this one.
relation_types.name: nests_artifact

relation_types.description: Comment::annotatedElement (§7.3.3) — the elements the comment is attached to.
relation_types.name: annotates

relation_types.description: Constraint::constrainedElement (§7.6.3) — the elements the condition applies to.
relation_types.name: constrains
